verdict.rationale: Square's developer docs include an 'Offline Payments' page under the Mobile Payments SDK for Android, a first-party offline-payments capability that fits this story. The pack contains only the page title, so store-and-forward behavior, sync on reconnect, limits and risk terms are not shown. Missing for 10: documented storage and forwarding of transactions when connectivity returns, coverage beyond the Android SDK (Square POS app, hardware, iOS), offline limits and risk terms, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can keep taking card payments when the internet drops, with transactions stored and forwarded when connectivity returns
